name: Powerusers AI

sources.title: Submit AI Tool — rules, $69 PayPal flow, FAQ

requirements: AI tools only — libraries, newsletters, and non-AI content are rejected
Direct https:// URL only — shortened URLs, redirects, and affiliate links are auto-discarded
No explicit pornographic content; NSFW tools may be declined (refunded) or listed without homepage exposure
Low-quality or highly duplicative tools rejected; 'websites named after certain AI models' no longer accepted
Check the existing directory first — duplicates won't be listed
$69 one-time via PayPal; listed forever, done-for-you listing, ~48h turnaround, full refund if declined
preparation: Submitter name, email, and PayPal email (used for submission reference)
Tool name and optional extra info for the listing
PayPal account for the $69 payment redirect
workflow: Search the directory to confirm the tool is not already listed
Open https://powerusers.ai/submit-ai-tool/ and fill the form (Name, Email, PayPal Email, Tool Name, Tool URL, optional details)
Submit — you are redirected to PayPal to pay $69
Editorial team reviews (up to ~48h), maps tool capabilities, and builds the listing
On approval you get a confirmation email with the listing link; request a content revision if needed
watchFor: Payment is via PayPal redirect after form submit — a PayPal email field is required up front
NSFW submissions risk a decline (refunded) or a listing that never appears on the homepage
Homepage featuring is a separate ask — contact dave[at]powerusers.ai, subject to availability
Site pushes a 'free login' modal for browsing but the listing itself is paid — don't confuse the two
countsAsLive: The tool has a live listing page on powerusers.ai with a custom (dark/light) banner and appears in its capability categories
